cn_steps: `MetaHumanRuntime` 是已弃用（Deprecated）插件，现已重定向到 `MetaHumanSDK`。
新项目改用 `MetaHumanSDK` / `MetaHumanSDKRuntime`。
旧工程若仍引用它，按提示迁移。
没有可依赖的运行时模块列表，迁移后禁用本插件。
en_steps: `MetaHumanRuntime` is a deprecated plugin now redirected to `MetaHumanSDK`.
New projects use `MetaHumanSDK` / `MetaHumanSDKRuntime`.
If a legacy project still references it, migrate as prompted.
It ships no runtime module list to depend on; disable it after migration.

cn_steps: 启用 `MetaHumanToolsetCore`（模块 `MetaHumanToolsetCore`）。
它为 MetaHuman 及相关 AI 工具集提供共享实用程序与 toast 通知。
通常作为上层 MetaHuman 工具集的共享依赖，不单独面向用户。
写自定义 MetaHuman 工具集时可直接依赖它复用通用能力。
en_steps: Enable `MetaHumanToolsetCore` (module `MetaHumanToolsetCore`).
It provides shared utilities and toast notifications for MetaHuman and related AI toolsets.
Usually a shared dependency for upper MetaHuman toolsets, not directly user-facing.
Depend on it directly when writing custom MetaHuman toolsets to reuse common capabilities.
note_cn: MetaHuman/AI 工具集的共享实用程序与 toast 通知底座。
note_en: Shared utilities and toast notifications base for MetaHuman/AI toolsets.

cn_steps: 启用 `Metasound Tests`（模块 `MetasoundTests`）。
它提供可复用的、与节点无关的 MetaSound 测试（独立 DSP 检查、新旧等效性）。
在自动化测试里跑这些用例，验证 MetaSound 节点行为。
这是测试插件，不要打进发行版本。
en_steps: Enable `Metasound Tests` (module `MetasoundTests`).
It provides reusable, node-agnostic MetaSound tests (isolated DSP checks and old-vs-new equivalence).
Run these cases in automation to validate MetaSound node behavior.
It is a test plugin; do not ship it in release builds.
note_cn: MetaSound 节点的可复用无关测试（DSP/新旧等效），测试用。
note_en: Reusable node-agnostic MetaSound tests (DSP/equivalence), for testing.

cn_steps: 启用 `MetaSound`（模块 `MetasoundGraphCore`、`MetasoundFrontend`、`MetasoundGenerator`、`MetasoundStandardNodes`、`MetasoundEngine`，编辑器 `MetasoundEditor`）。
用节点图做音频合成：振荡、滤波、调制，运行时按游戏数据/蓝图参数精确生成声音。
创建 MetaSound Source/Preset 资产，挂到 Sound 组件播放，用参数实时调制。
Game 模块依赖运行时模块；`MetasoundEditor`/Test 模块只进 Editor Target。
en_steps: Enable `MetaSound` (modules `MetasoundGraphCore`, `MetasoundFrontend`, `MetasoundGenerator`, `MetasoundStandardNodes`, `MetasoundEngine`, editor `MetasoundEditor`).
Synthesize audio in a node graph: oscillators, filters, modulation, generating sound at runtime driven by game data/Blueprint params.
Create MetaSound Source/Preset assets, play them via a Sound component, and modulate with parameters in real time.
Game modules depend on runtime modules; `MetasoundEditor`/test modules go to Editor targets only.
note_cn: MetaSound 节点图音频合成系统（“音频界的 Niagara”）。
note_en: The MetaSound node-graph audio synthesis system ("Niagara for audio").

cn_steps: 启用 Experimental 的 `Metasounds Experimental`（模块 `AudioExperimentalRuntime`、`MetasoundExperimentalRuntime`、`MetasoundExperimentalEngineRuntime`、`MetasoundExperimentalEditor`）。
它是 MetaSound 实验性运行时/引擎扩展，验证新特性（振荡、滤波、调制等）。
在新特性灰度项目里用它替换/补充稳定版 MetaSound 运行时。
Experimental：接口可能变动；先在非关键流程验证。
en_steps: Enable Experimental `Metasounds Experimental` (modules `AudioExperimentalRuntime`, `MetasoundExperimentalRuntime`, `MetasoundExperimentalEngineRuntime`, `MetasoundExperimentalEditor`).
It is the experimental MetaSound runtime/engine extension for new features (oscillators, filters, modulation, etc.).
In new-feature pilot projects, use it to replace/complement the stable MetaSound runtime.
Experimental: contract may change; prove it on non-critical flows first.
note_cn: MetaSound 的实验性运行时/引擎扩展。

cn_steps: 启用 Experimental 的 `MetaSoundToolset`（模块 `MetaSoundToolset`），面向 AI Toolset Registry。
让 AI 助手通过工具集创作与检查 MetaSound 图。
在 MetaSound 编辑流程里用 AI 助手批量/程序化生成图表。
这是开发期工具集，不是运行时音频；Experimental。
en_steps: Enable Experimental `MetaSoundToolset` (module `MetaSoundToolset`); it targets the AI Toolset Registry.
Let AI assistants author and inspect MetaSound graphs via the toolset.
In the MetaSound editing flow, use the AI assistant to batch/procedurally build graphs.
It is a development-time toolset, not runtime audio; Experimental.
note_cn: 创作/检查 MetaSound 图的 AI 工具集。
note_en: An AI toolset to author/inspect MetaSound graphs.

cn_steps: 启用 `Microsoft GDK Runtime Plug-in for Unreal Engine`（模块 `MSGamingRuntime`），面向 Windows。
它为 Windows 游戏提供 GDK 运行时能力（如用户、网络、存档等平台服务）。
构建/部署到 GDK 目标，用其接口调用平台运行时功能。
只在 GDK/Windows 目标使用；需对应 GDK 环境。
en_steps: Enable `Microsoft GDK Runtime Plug-in for Unreal Engine` (module `MSGamingRuntime`) for Windows.
It provides GDK runtime capabilities (platform services like users, networking, storage) for Windows games.
Build/deploy to a GDK target and call platform runtime features through its API.
Use it on GDK/Windows targets only; requires the GDK environment.
note_cn: Windows 游戏的 GDK 运行时能力（平台服务）。
note_en: GDK runtime capabilities (platform services) for Windows games.

cn_steps: 启用 `Microsoft GDK Store Plug-in for Unreal Engine`（模块 `MSGameStore`），面向 Windows。
它允许打包 Windows 游戏以提交到 Xbox PC App（商店相关）。
在打包/商店提交流程里配置相应设置。
只在提交 Xbox PC App 的 Windows 目标使用。
en_steps: Enable `Microsoft GDK Store Plug-in for Unreal Engine` (module `MSGameStore`) for Windows.
It lets you package Windows games for submission to the Xbox PC App (store-related).
Configure the relevant settings in the packaging/store submission flow.
Use it on Windows targets submitted to the Xbox PC App only.
note_cn: 打包 Windows 游戏提交到 Xbox PC App 的商店插件。
note_en: A store plugin to package Windows games for the Xbox PC App.

cn_steps: 启用 `MicrosoftSpatialSound`（模块 `MicrosoftSpatialSound`），面向空间音频。
它用 Microsoft SASAPI 服务做音频空间化（HRTF/对象音频）。
在项目音频设置里启用该空间化插件，接入相应设备/服务。
只在支持的 Windows 平台/设备使用。
en_steps: Enable `MicrosoftSpatialSound` (module `MicrosoftSpatialSound`) for spatial audio.
It uses Microsoft's SASAPI service for audio spatialization (HRTF/object audio).
Enable this spatialization plugin in project audio settings and hook up the matching device/service.
Use it on supported Windows platforms/devices only.
note_cn: 用 Microsoft SASAPI 的音频空间化插件。
note_en: An audio spatialization plugin using Microsoft SASAPI.

cn_steps: 启用 `MIDI Device Support`（模块 `MIDIDevice`）。
通过简单 API 在 C++ 或蓝图里发送/接收 MIDI 事件。
枚举 MIDI 输入/输出设备，绑定回调处理音符/控制变化（CC）。
运行时模块可进游戏包；用于接 MIDI 控制器或外部音序器。
en_steps: Enable `MIDI Device Support` (module `MIDIDevice`).
Send/receive MIDI events through a simple API in C++ or Blueprint.
Enumerate MIDI input/output devices and bind callbacks for notes/control changes (CC).
Runtime modules can ship; use it to hook MIDI controllers or external sequencers.
note_cn: C++/蓝图收发 MIDI 事件的设备支持。
note_en: MIDI device support to send/receive MIDI events from C++/Blueprint.

cn_steps: 启用 `Mixed Reality Capture Framework`（模块 `MixedRealityCaptureFramework`），面向 VR。
它提供一个简单框架，把混合现实捕获（MRC）集成到 VR 项目。
配置捕获相机/合成，把真实与虚拟画面合成输出。
运行时模块；需 VR + 捕获硬件配合。
en_steps: Enable `Mixed Reality Capture Framework` (module `MixedRealityCaptureFramework`) for VR.
It provides a simple framework to integrate mixed reality capture (MRC) into VR projects.
Configure the capture camera/compositing to combine real and virtual footage.
A runtime module; requires VR plus capture hardware.
note_cn: 把混合现实捕获(MRC)集成到 VR 项目的框架。
note_en: A framework to integrate mixed reality capture (MRC) into VR projects.

cn_steps: 启用 `ML Adapter`（模块 `MLAdapter`，测试 `MLAdapterTestSuite`）。
它是在游戏中训练和使用机器学习代理的框架：提供 RPC 接口，外部进程可查询游戏状态并控制 Actor。
训练后，代理可通过从 ONNX 模型加载的神经网络在引擎内运行。
Game 模块依赖 `MLAdapter`；测试模块不进游戏包。
en_steps: Enable `ML Adapter` (module `MLAdapter`, tests `MLAdapterTestSuite`).
It is a framework for training and using ML agents in games: an RPC interface lets an external process query game state and control actors.
After training, agents can run in-engine via a neural network loaded from an ONNX model.
Game modules depend on `MLAdapter`; keep the test module out of the cooked game.
note_cn: 游戏内 ML 代理训练/使用框架（RPC + ONNX 推理）。
note_en: A framework for training/using ML agents in games (RPC + ONNX inference).

cn_steps: 启用 Experimental 的 `ML Deformer Detail Pose Model`（运行时 `DetailPoseModel`，编辑器 `DetailPoseModelEditor`）。
它是 ML Deformer 框架的“详细姿势模型”，提高变形精度。
在 ML Deformer 资产里选择 Detail Pose Model，训练后驱动网格变形。
Experimental：接口可能变动；`DetailPoseModelEditor` 只进 Editor Target。
en_steps: Enable Experimental `ML Deformer Detail Pose Model` (runtime `DetailPoseModel`, editor `DetailPoseModelEditor`).
It is the Detail Pose Model for the ML Deformer framework, improving deformation accuracy.
Select Detail Pose Model in an ML Deformer asset; after training, drive mesh deformation.
Experimental: contract may change; `DetailPoseModelEditor` is Editor-target only.
note_cn: ML Deformer 的详细姿势模型（提高精度），替代最近邻模型。
note_en: The ML Deformer Detail Pose Model (higher accuracy), replacing the nearest-neighbor model.

cn_steps: 启用 `ML Deformer Framework`（运行时 `MLDeformerFramework`，编辑器 `MLDeformerFrameworkEditor`）。
它是机器学习网格变形器框架：用训练模型驱动骨骼网格的变形细节。
创建 ML Deformer 资产、选模型、训练并应用到角色，PIE 验证变形。
Game 模块依赖 `MLDeformerFramework`；`MLDeformerFrameworkEditor` 只进 Editor Target。
en_steps: Enable `ML Deformer Framework` (runtime `MLDeformerFramework`, editor `MLDeformerFrameworkEditor`).
It is the machine-learning mesh deformer framework: trained models drive skeletal mesh deformation detail.
Create an ML Deformer asset, pick a model, train, apply to the character, and verify in PIE.
Game modules depend on `MLDeformerFramework`; `MLDeformerFrameworkEditor` is Editor-target only.
note_cn: 机器学习网格变形器框架（基础），模型是可插拔的。
note_en: The ML mesh deformer framework (base); models are pluggable.

cn_steps: `ML Deformer Nearest Neighbor Model` 已弃用（DEPRECATED）。
改用 `ML Deformer Detail Pose Model`。
不要在 `Build.cs` 新增对该过时模型的依赖。
迁移完成后禁用本插件。
en_steps: `ML Deformer Nearest Neighbor Model` is deprecated (DEPRECATED).
Use `ML Deformer Detail Pose Model` instead.
Do not add new `Build.cs` dependencies on this deprecated model.
Disable this plugin after migration.
note_cn: 已弃用，改用 Detail Pose Model。
note_en: Deprecated; use the Detail Pose Model instead.
